data.name: Saksham
data.long_meaning: The name Saksham is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saksh' which means 'to witness'. The name Saksham means 'able to see or perceive' and is given to a child who is believed to have the ability to observe and understand the world around them with clarity and wisdom. This name is often given to a child who is expected to be courageous and truthful in their actions and words.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Saksham holds spiritual significance as it is believed to bring the blessings of the God of Sight, Agni, who is the witness of all actions and the purifier of all sins. The name is said to instil in the child a sense of transparency and courage, and the ability to see beyond the physical world.
